title: The Minoan civilization was not destroyed by the eruption of Thera and was not the inspiration for Plato's parable of Atlantis.
body: The Minoan civilization was not destroyed by the eruption of Thera and was not the inspiration for Plato's parable of Atlantis. Rather, the settlement on Thera itself (Akrotiri) was completely destroyed and preserved under volcanic ash, much like Pompeii, and was likely a Minoan settlement.
